belief_statement: Preliminary evidence indicates that cedar japanese planed room may influence cognitive performance. The evidence base (7 findings, 1 studies) is growing but not yet conclusive.

mechanisms.pathway: cedar japanese planed room → [unknown mechanism] → cognitive performance

latent_variables.name: Dose and duration
latent_variables.rationale: Most studies measure presence/absence of cedar japanese planed room, not dose-response curves. Duration and intensity likely matter.
latent_variables.suggested_measure: Parametric variation of intensity and exposure duration

research_needs.question: Does the effect of cedar japanese planed room on cognitive performance replicate in a pre-registered RCT?
research_needs.rationale: Current confidence is moderate. A well-powered pre-registered replication would most efficiently resolve the status of this belief.

research_needs.question: What is the dose-response curve for cedar japanese planed room effects on cognitive performance?
research_needs.rationale: Dose-response data enables design guidelines with specific thresholds.
